_readme: Authors excluded from The Classics outright. Ten or more entries on the Philosophers: the reader who wants them has a year of them, and theirs is the most corrupted quotation trade. check-year.js reads the same list from its CLASSICS_BANNED; this copy is the one the curator briefs are built from.
out_of_scope: scripture and liturgy (the Library owns them)
film and television lines (the lift bank owns them)
proverbs and anonymous traditions (the Philosophers' Wisdom tag owns them)
anything that would need a content warning
